premise: forced eviction; hidden-swap-ms not wall clock; Fresh-277 cannot exhibit contention
verdict: Repo gain is -10.7 pp (kv=3500) and -11.0 pp (kv=5000), under the frozen 5 pp bar, so repository identity does NOT materially reduce within-key variance. The stronger result is that BOTH fine keys have NEGATIVE leave-one-out ceilings: honestly evaluated, they lose to the plain deadline.

what_this_corrects.8e7ed28: Its as-frozen GO, repo gain 38.5 and 45.7 pp, was entirely an overfitting artifact. The overfit is 1214.9 s and 1416.1 s for repo+cmd, larger than the whole budget of 1392.1 s and 1477.6 s. Its debiased inconclusive reading, 15.0 and 13.9 pp, was closer but still optimistic because the size-5 restriction leaves the scored row inside its own fit.
what_this_corrects.3bc4906: Its framing of roughly 70% unreachable and roughly 30% reachable in principle is wrong in the optimistic direction. Honestly evaluated the reachable share is not 30% but negative, so effectively 100% of the budget is out of reach for per-key empirical methods on this corpus.

bounds_interpretation: In-sample and LOO bracket the truth from opposite sides and the bracket is enormous for fine keys: -232 s to +982 s at kv=3500 for repo+cmd. In-sample leaks because the scored row is inside its own fit. LOO is pessimistic because with about 3 rows per key it fits on roughly 2 samples. The honest reading is not a point estimate but the diagnosis that fine keys are TOO SPARSE TO ESTIMATE at this corpus size: coverage, not information, is the binding constraint.
not_merely_a_LOO_artifact: profile_trigger in 3bc4906 fits on the profile folds, four fifths of the corpus, far more data than LOO, and it too loses to deadline_only at kv=3500 (1515.6 s against 1565.4 s). Two independent honest estimators, one fitting on more data and one on less, both fail to beat the deadline. That is not a sample-size quirk of LOO.
transfers_to_continuum: Continuum's P(tau,f) is a per-key empirical CDF, a member of exactly this family. On this workload, evaluated without leakage, the family does not beat a fixed deadline. Combined with 8e7ed28's unconfounded finding that a tool_name key reaches 0.9% of the budget even in-sample, the estimator class is bounded near zero here.
